budgets_starts_on_period.name: budgets_starts_on_period
budgets_starts_on_period.value:
extract(day from "budgets"."budgets"."starts_on") = 1 and ("budgets"."budgets"."period" = 'monthly'
        or ("budgets"."budgets"."period" = 'quarterly' and extract(month from "budgets"."budgets"."starts_on") in (1, 4, 7, 10))
        or ("budgets"."budgets"."period" = 'yearly' and extract(month from "budgets"."budgets"."starts_on") = 1))

debts_rate.name: debts_rate
debts_rate.value: ("debts"."debts"."rate" is null) = ("debts"."debts"."rate_period" is null) and ("debts"."debts"."rate" is null or "debts"."debts"."rate" >= 0)

debts_days.name: debts_days
debts_days.value: ("debts"."debts"."due_day" is null or "debts"."debts"."due_day" between 1 and 31) and ("debts"."debts"."statement_day" is null or "debts"."debts"."statement_day" between 1 and 31)

debts_amounts.name: debts_amounts
debts_amounts.value:
("debts"."debts"."original_principal_minor" is null or "debts"."debts"."original_principal_minor" > 0)
      and ("debts"."debts"."installment_minor" is null or "debts"."debts"."installment_minor" > 0)
      and ("debts"."debts"."credit_limit_minor" is null or "debts"."debts"."credit_limit_minor" > 0)

accounts_kind_shape.name: accounts_kind_shape
accounts_kind_shape.value:
(("ledger"."accounts"."system_role" is null and "ledger"."accounts"."kind" = 'asset' and "ledger"."accounts"."subtype" in ('bank', 'cash', 'wallet', 'savings', 'investment', 'receivable', 'other_asset'))
       or ("ledger"."accounts"."system_role" is null and "ledger"."accounts"."kind" = 'liability' and "ledger"."accounts"."subtype" in ('credit_card', 'loan', 'payable', 'other_liability'))
       or ("ledger"."accounts"."system_role" = 'income' and "ledger"."accounts"."kind" = 'income' and "ledger"."accounts"."subtype" is null)
       or ("ledger"."accounts"."system_role" = 'expense' and "ledger"."accounts"."kind" = 'expense' and "ledger"."accounts"."subtype" is null)
       or ("ledger"."accounts"."system_role" in ('opening_balance', 'valuation') and "ledger"."accounts"."kind" = 'equity' and "ledger"."accounts"."subtype" is null)
       or ("ledger"."accounts"."system_role" = 'fx' and "ledger"."accounts"."kind" = 'clearing' and "ledger"."accounts"."subtype" is null)) is true
